sourceDecisionQuestions.question: Sheathing and deck refer to roof substrate in the source scene, while archived platelage de toiture and support de couverture may imply different structural layers. Choose approved French trade terms and align the imperatives before scored use.
The source says soft or damaged deck and soft panel. Archived affaibli weakens the tactile soft condition, and semble replaces feels. Retain the observed condition without diagnosing a repair method.
The source term damage is singular or mass; archived les dommages is plural. Resolve the dictionary sense and article for a field-reporting card.

The worker feels rotten wood while stepping on a panel; archived constate changes tactile observation into a conclusion. Preserve the source observation and stop/work-hold command. A qualified person must assess the damaged deck before any repair procedure is taught.

Source speaking asks the supervisor to stop a worker about to cover a soft panel and request a repair. Archived speaking adds marking and verification of a planned repair. Keep those extra actions separate from scored source meaning until source and roofing review decide the objective.

The source says this plywood needs replacement, not that the dialogue alone determines an approved structural repair. Keep any competent-person assessment as a separate domain note rather than silently changing the direct learner vocabulary.
